findings.current: 他们还发现，沿高速公路增设快速充电站，并让那些需要出行到自家电动汽车单次充电续航里程以外的人更容易用上补充车辆，可能会大大提升车辆电气化的潜力。
findings.proposed: 他们还发现，沿高速公路增设快速充电站，并让那些需要出行的距离超出自家电动汽车单次充电续航里程的人更容易用上补充车辆，可能会大大提升车辆电气化的潜力。
findings.reason: “出行到……续航里程以外”搭配不通。人不会“出行到”一个里程数，这是照搬 travel beyond the range 的翻译腔。英文的意思是出行距离超过单次充电续航里程，应把“距离”说出来。

findings.current: 正如特兰西克和她的同事们此前报告过的，虽然现有较便宜的电动汽车所提供的续航里程，就能满足人们绝大部分的日常驾驶需求，但通常总有那么几次，人们需要开得远得多。
findings.proposed: 虽然正如特兰西克和她的同事们此前报告过的，现有较便宜的电动汽车所提供的续航里程就能满足人们绝大部分的日常驾驶需求，但通常总有那么几次，人们需要开得远得多。
findings.reason: 英文的 as-clause 紧跟在 while 从句后面，用逗号隔开，所以“此前报告过的”是“续航里程能满足绝大部分日常需求”这一点。初稿把它放到句首，范围扩大到整句，连主句（需要开远得多）也算进了此前报告的内容，归属范围不准。

findings.current: 他说：“激励扩建这类充电基础设施的方式多种多样。”
findings.proposed: 他说：“以激励措施推动这类充电基础设施扩建的方式多种多样。”
findings.reason: “激励”一般接人或主体作宾语（激励企业），“激励扩建”搭配生硬。incentivize the expansion 指用激励措施推动扩建，应把“激励措施”和“推动”都说出来。

findings.current: 在所有这些情境中，住处的充电选择都是关键。
findings.proposed: 在研究设想的各种情境中，住处的充电选择都是关键。
findings.reason: 概要前文没有提到任何“情境”。“所有这些情境”在概要里没有可指的对象，容易让读者误以为指前面两项发现。原文 these scenarios 指的是第[25]、[26]句列出的几种基础设施组合，概要里应说成“研究设想的各种情境”。

findings.current: 对于正在想方设法推动温室气体减排的各级政策制定者，这项研究应该有助于提供一些指导，因为在温室气体排放总量中，交通运输部门约占三分之一。
findings.proposed: 这项研究应该有助于为正在想方设法推动温室气体减排的各级政策制定者提供一些指导，因为交通运输部门的排放约占温室气体排放总量的三分之一。
findings.reason: “对于X，……有助于提供指导”搭配不当：提供指导的对象应该用“为X提供”。原句把对象提到句首，用“对于”引出，读起来像英语语序。后半句“在……总量中，……部门约占”也比较绕，改成“……的排放约占……总量的三分之一”更顺。

findings.current: 特兰西克说：“真的非常重要的一点是，无论人们在住处附近的什么地方停车较长时间（往往是过夜），都要为他们提供充电条件——可靠、可预期的充电条件。”
findings.proposed: 特兰西克说：“真的很重要的一点是，无论人们在住处附近的什么地方较长时间停车（往往是过夜），都要为他们提供充电条件——可靠、可预期的充电条件。”
findings.reason: “停车”是离合词，后面直接带时量补语（“停车较长时间”）不合汉语语法，应说“较长时间停车”或“停较长时间的车”。另外“真的非常”两个程度词叠用，显得累赘，用“真的很”就能对应 really important。

findings.current: 研究人员的一项新研究揭示了哪些类型的基础设施改进最能增加道路上的电动汽车数量，而增加电动汽车数量是减少交通运输领域温室气体排放的关键一步。
findings.proposed: 研究人员开展的一项新研究揭示了哪些类型的基础设施改进最能增加上路电动汽车的数量，而增加电动汽车数量是减少交通运输领域温室气体排放的关键一步。
findings.reason: “研究人员的一项新研究”前后都是“研究”，用“的”表领属显得同义重复、生硬，改成“研究人员开展的”更自然。“道路上的电动汽车数量”是照着 on the road 直译，改成“上路电动汽车的数量”更地道，“上路”也仍能对应高亮的 on the road。

findings.current: 又或者，他们可能需要在一天之内跑比平时更多的短途，几乎没有时间停下来充电。
findings.proposed: 又或者，他们一天之内需要跑的短途可能比平时多，几乎没有时间停下来充电。
findings.reason: “跑比平时更多的短途”把 more…than usual 整个塞进动宾之间，是英语比较结构的直译，读起来别扭。改成“需要跑的短途……比平时多”是汉语常用的比较说法，may need to 的意思也保留了。

findings.current: 汽车公司甚至可能会发现，自行提供便捷的租车服务或与租车服务商合作，以此帮助带动自家电动汽车的销售，对自己有利。
findings.proposed: 汽车公司甚至可能会发现，自行提供便捷的租车服务或与此类租车服务商合作，借此帮助带动自家电动汽车的销售，是有利之举。
findings.reason: 一大串主语之后用“，对自己有利”收尾，头重脚轻，“对自己”也多余。改成“是有利之举”更顺。另外原文 convenient 同时修饰 provide 和 partner with 的租车服务，原译里合作对象漏了这层意思，用“此类”补上。

findings.current: 重要的是，在所有这些情境中，住处的充电选择（路内或路外）都是关键。
findings.proposed: 重要的是，在所有这些情景下，住处的充电选择（路内或路外）都是关键。
findings.reason: 研究、建模里的 scenario 通行译法是“情景”（情景分析、排放情景）。“情境”多指 context 或某种处境，用在这里不是规范术语。概要里的“在所有这些情境中”也应同步改（scenario 的释义里的“情境”，可以请负责释义的复核人一并考虑）。

findings.current: on- or off-street  (短语)  路内或路外的
findings.reason: "on- or off-street" is two hyphenated compound adjectives joined by "or", with the hyphen of "on-street" suspended. It is a free coordination, not a fixed phrase, so rule (5) says it should not be labelled 短语, and no dictionary has it as a headword. Replace it with the real dictionary word (see the add finding below). "off-street parking" in [29] already covers the related phrase.

findings.proposed: off-street=adj. 路外的；不在街道上的（on-street 路内的、街边的）
findings.reason: This replaces the pseudo-phrase "on- or off-street". "off-street" is the dictionary headword (adj.). The gloss also gives "on-street" so the learner still understands "on- or off-street".

findings.current: 整体上；总体来看
findings.proposed: 作为一个整体；整个（……）
findings.reason: In "the country as a whole", the phrase follows a noun and means "the whole country, taken as one unit" (全国整体). "总体来看" is the meaning of "on the whole" (总的来说), a different phrase, so the gloss blurs two phrases that learners often confuse.

findings.current: highest-capacity
findings.proposed: high-capacity
findings.reason: "highest-capacity" is the superlative of a compound adjective, not a dictionary form. Dictionaries list "high-capacity" (adj. 大容量的). The highlight can stay "highest-capacity".

findings.current: adj. 容量最大的
findings.proposed: adj. 大容量的（此处 highest-capacity：容量最大的）
findings.reason: This goes with the headword change to "high-capacity". The gloss gives the dictionary meaning and also the superlative sense used in this sentence.

findings.current: lower-cost
findings.proposed: low-cost
findings.reason: "lower-cost" is the comparative of a compound adjective, not a dictionary form. Dictionaries list "low-cost" (adj. 低成本的；廉价的). The current gloss "成本较低的；较便宜的" can stay as the meaning in this sentence, and the highlight can stay "lower-cost".

findings.current: lower-cost
findings.proposed: low-cost
findings.reason: Same as [14]: the dictionary headword is "low-cost"; "lower-cost" is its comparative.

findings.proposed: home=n. 家庭；住户
findings.reason: "the number of homes that could meet their driving needs" uses "home" to mean a household (a counted unit), not a house or 家 in the everyday sense. The ZH correctly says 家庭, but this sense is worth memorising and has no entry.

findings.proposed: across=prep. 在（所有……）中；遍及
findings.reason: In "key across all of these scenarios", "across" has the abstract sense "throughout / in every one of", not the basic "穿过". This sense is common in academic and journalistic English and has no entry.

findings.current: 特兰西克认为，资金有限时排定优先次序非常重要，而这项研究应该有助于为各级政策制定者提供一些指导。
findings.proposed: 这项研究应该有助于为各级政策制定者提供一些指导；特兰西克指出，资金有限时排定优先次序非常重要。
findings.reason: Wrong attribution. In [33] the claim that the study should give guidance to policymakers at all levels is the writer's, not Trancik's. Trancik's own point in [34] is about prioritising when funds are limited. Because the current wording puts both clauses under 特兰西克认为, both are credited to her.

findings.current: 特兰西克说：“如果资金有限——通常总是如此——那么排定优先次序就真的非常重要。”她还指出，这项研究或许能指明哪些领域可能为这些投资带来最大的回报。
findings.proposed: 特兰西克说：“如果资金有限——通常总是如此——那么排定优先次序就真的非常重要。”她还指出，这项研究或许能指明，把这些资金投向哪些领域能获得最大的回报。
findings.reason: 'those investments' points back to the limited funds in the quote. The ZH 这些投资 has no antecedent anywhere in the Chinese text. 领域为投资带来回报 is also translationese. Saying 把这些资金投向哪些领域 ties the reference to 资金 and reads idiomatically.

findings.current: “我认为，重视这些影响大的做法非常关键，比如想办法在公共街道上做到这一点，而不是随随便便地在杂货店、商场或其他任何公共场所装个充电桩。”
findings.proposed: “我认为，重视这些影响大的做法非常关键，比如想办法在公共街道上做到这一点，而不是随随便便地在杂货店、购物中心或其他任何公共场所装个充电桩。”
findings.reason: Inconsistent term. [32] deliberately echoes [2] ('residential streets rather than ... shopping malls'), and [2] and the summary both use 购物中心. Switching to 商场 here hides the echo. One key term should get one Chinese rendering.

va.why: The current text matches the file. The phrase 出行到……续航里程以外 does not work in Chinese. The proposal names the travel distance that exceeds the single-charge range, which is exactly what the English says, and it keeps 'need to'.

In the English, the as-clause comes straight after the while-clause and attaches to it. Trancik's earlier reported finding was that cheaper EVs meet most daily needs. The proposal limits 正如…报告过的 to that claim, and it also removes the stray comma after 续航里程.
激励扩建 is a stiff collocation. 以激励措施推动……扩建 renders 'incentivize the expansion' precisely, and the rest of the line is unchanged.

va.amended_proposed: 在研究设想的各种情景下，住处的充电选择都是关键。
va.why: The problem is real: 这些情境 has nothing to refer to in the summary. The fix is right, but it uses 情景 so that it agrees with finding 9, since 情景 is the standard term for modelling scenarios.

为X提供指导 is the correct construction, and 交通运输部门的排放约占……总量的三分之一 is both precise and smoother. No content is lost: the 'looking for ways to facilitate' clause and 'about a third … overall' are both still there.
The grammar claim is wrong. 停车 followed by a duration is standard Chinese (停车两小时, 停车较长时间). 真的非常 and 真的很 are equivalent. The rewrite is not clearly more natural, and the current line is accurate.
研究人员开展的 removes the clumsy 研究人员的一项新研究 repetition. 上路电动汽车的数量 matches 'on the road' and the gloss 上路行驶的. Every clause stays precise.
跑比平时更多的短途 is an English comparative copied into Chinese. 一天之内需要跑的短途可能比平时多 keeps 'may need to', 'more … than usual' and 'in a day', and it reads naturally.

va.amended_proposed: 汽车公司甚至可能会发现，为帮助带动自家电动汽车的销售，自行提供便捷的租车服务或与此类租车服务商合作，是有利之举。
va.why: The 此类 fix is valid, because 'convenient' also qualifies the partner services. But the proposal is still head-heavy, with a long subject chain followed by 借此…是有利之举. The amendment moves the purpose clause ('to help drive … sales') to the front so the sentence reads cleanly. The meaning is unchanged.
'Scenario' in a modelling or energy study is conventionally 情景 (情景分析, 排放情景). 情境 means context or situation, so 情景 is the more precise term here.
'on- or off-street' is a coordination with a suspended hyphen, not a phrase, so it should not be labelled 短语. Dropping it is right, provided the off-street entry in finding 11 replaces it.
off-street is the real dictionary headword (adj.). 路外的 is the standard Chinese traffic term (路外停车 vs 路内停车). The note on on-street lets learners still read 'on- or off-street'.
In 'the country as a whole' the phrase follows the noun and means 'taken as a single unit'. 总体来看 is the sense of 'on the whole'. 作为一个整体；整个（……） is the precise gloss.
Headwords use the dictionary form. high-capacity is the lemma and highest-capacity is its superlative. The highlight stays highest-capacity.
This goes with finding 13. The gloss gives the dictionary sense and the superlative sense used in this sentence. adj. is the correct part of speech.
low-cost is the dictionary headword and lower-cost is its comparative. The highlight stays lower-cost. The existing gloss 成本较低的；较便宜的 still fits.
This is the same lemma fix as finding 15, applied to sentence 25.
home is an elementary word. Its 'household' sense here is the everyday Chinese 家, and the translation already gives 家庭. It is not a separate learning point a TEM-8 student needs to memorise.

'key across all of these scenarios' uses the abstract sense of across, meaning in every one of or throughout. This is common in academic English and differs from the basic sense 穿过. prep. 在（所有……）中；遍及 is correct.
领域为投资带来回报 is translationese. 'those investments' means the spending of the limited funds just mentioned. 把这些资金投向哪些领域能获得最大的回报 is accurate and idiomatic, and 或许能指明 keeps 'could indicate'.

In [33], the claim that the study should guide policymakers is the writer's, not Trancik's. The current wording puts both clauses under 特兰西克认为, which misattributes it. The proposal separates the writer's claim from Trancik's point about prioritising.
[32] echoes [2] (shopping malls → 购物中心), and the gloss of mall lists 购物中心 first. Using one rendering for the same term is consistent and loses no precision.

vb.why: "出行到……续航里程以外" is a real collocation error: you can't 出行到 a range. The proposal is precise, natural, and matches the summary's 出行距离超出.

The as-clause sits inside the while-clause, so it most naturally scopes over the low-cost-EV finding. The current version extends it to the main clause. 虽然正如……报告过的，……，但…… is normal Chinese and more faithful.

激励扩建…… (verb + verb) reads stiff. The proposal spells out incentivize as 以激励措施推动, which is clearer and still exact. The claim that 激励 only takes people is overstated (激励创新 is fine), but the change is still an improvement.

vb.amended_proposed: 在研究设想的各种情景下，住处的充电选择都是关键。
vb.why: Right: 这些情境 has no antecedent in the summary. The term should follow index 9 (情景, the standard rendering of a modelling scenario), so it reads 情景下.
对于X，……有助于提供指导 is a broken frame; 为X提供指导 is the correct one. 交通运输部门的排放约占……总量的三分之一 is smoother and stays exact.
较长时间停车 (or 长时间停车) is the idiomatic order. 停车较长时间 is tolerable in speech but clumsy in writing. 真的很 matches 'really important' equally well. No meaning change.

vb.amended_proposed: 研究人员开展的一项新研究揭示了哪些类型的基础设施改进最能增加上路行驶的电动汽车数量，而增加电动汽车数量是减少交通运输领域温室气体排放的关键一步。
vb.why: 研究人员的一项新研究 is clunky, so 开展的 is a real fix. 上路电动汽车的数量 is compressed; 上路行驶的电动汽车数量 is more natural and matches the on-the-road gloss 上路行驶的.
跑比平时更多的短途 copies the English comparative into the verb–object slot. 需要跑的短途可能比平时多 is idiomatic and keeps 'may need to'.
The trailing ，对自己有利 is top-heavy and the 对自己 is redundant; 是有利之举 fixes both. 此类 restores the 'convenient' that also modifies partner-with. Meaning is preserved.

For modelled infrastructure scenarios, 情景 is the standard term (情景分析, 排放情景). 情境 means context or situation, so this is terminological precision, not taste. The scenario gloss and the summary should follow.
'on- or off-street' is a free coordination with a suspended hyphen, not a lexical phrase, so it shouldn't be a 短语 headword. Index 11 replaces it.
off-street (adj.) is the real dictionary headword. 路外的 and 路内的 are the standard parking terms, and noting on-street in the gloss still lets the learner decode the whole expression.
After a noun, 'as a whole' means taken as one unit (全国整体). 总体来看 is the sense of 'on the whole', a classic learner confusion. The new gloss is exact.
high-capacity is the dictionary form; highest-capacity is its superlative. Lemmatising matches how the other headwords are handled, and the highlight stays.
Goes with index 13. It gives the dictionary meaning plus the superlative sense used in this sentence. Accurate.
low-cost is the dictionary form; lower-cost is its comparative. The existing gloss 成本较低的；较便宜的 remains a valid gloss for low-cost in context.
Same as index 15, and keeps [14] and [25] consistent.

'homes' here is a counted household or dwelling unit, which the ZH correctly renders 家庭. Given the draft's threshold (data, result, goal are annotated), this sense is worth an entry, and the gloss is correct.
This 'across' means throughout or in every one of, an abstract sense that is common in academic English and not obvious from 穿过. The gloss is accurate.
A real misattribution: in [33] the writer, not Trancik, says the study should guide policymakers. The proposal separates the two claims correctly.
这些投资 has no Chinese antecedent, and 领域为投资带来回报 is translationese. 把这些资金投向哪些领域能获得最大的回报 ties back to 资金 in the quote and stays exact.
mall is rendered 购物中心 in [2] and in the summary, and [32] echoes [2]. One term should get one rendering for learners. 购物中心 is accurate.

findings.current: 干活的时候，你总得提防躲在灌木丛里的公司主管。
findings.proposed: 干活的时候，你总得提防有公司主管躲在灌木丛里。
findings.reason: In the English, 'a company official hiding in the bushes' is indefinite: you watch out in case an official is hiding there. The draft makes 躲在灌木丛里的 a modifier of 公司主管, which reads as if a particular official really is hiding there. Moving the clause after 有 restores the 'in case' sense.

findings.current: 最后，你会沿着铁轨走过去，发现领班厌恶至极。
findings.proposed: 最后，你会沿着铁轨走过去，发现领班已经厌烦透顶。
findings.reason: 'in a deep state of disgust' describes the foreman being thoroughly fed up and exasperated with the novice. In Chinese, 厌恶 normally needs an object, so 领班厌恶至极 standing alone reads unnaturally. 厌烦透顶 gives the same strong feeling of exasperation and reads naturally on its own.

findings.current: 作者的生活一路走下坡路时，看到
findings.proposed: 作者在生活一路走下坡路时看到
findings.reason: With 的, “作者的生活” becomes the subject of 看到 and of the following verbs (当作、坐在、感到), so the sentence says the author's life saw the ad. Making 作者 the subject fixes the dangling subject.

findings.current: 无能为力，任由那运动的宿命带着自己向前，感觉真好。
findings.proposed: 无能为力，任由列车运动的宿命带着自己向前，感觉真好。
findings.reason: Standing alone, “那运动” is ambiguous in Chinese: it most easily reads as a campaign or a sport, so “那运动的宿命” comes across as translationese. “that motion” means the train's motion. Saying 列车 resolves the ambiguity and keeps 运动 for the gloss.

findings.current: 他们开设了一门为期两周的课程，讲授规章手册——一份三百页的文件，有双重目的：一是防止列车相互碰撞，二是防止出现任何可能让公司遭到起诉的情况。
findings.proposed: 他们开设了一门为期两周的课程，讲授规章手册——这份三百页的文件有双重目的：一是防止列车相互碰撞，二是防止出现任何可能让公司遭到起诉的情况。
findings.reason: “一份三百页的文件，有双重目的” copies the English apposition “a … document with a dual purpose”, and the comma cuts the subject off from its predicate. “这份……文件有双重目的” is a proper Chinese clause.

In 'fancy academic job', fancy means prestigious or impressive. 高档的 is used for goods and services such as hotels and restaurants, which is the wrong sense for a learner here. 体面的 fits a job.

findings.current: 这道涌浪所蓄的海水中，最小的一部分轰然砸在了我们身上。
findings.proposed: 这道涌浪所蓄的海水，只有极小的一部分轰然砸在了我们身上。
findings.reason: 'The smallest portion' is an emphatic superlative meaning 'only the tiniest fraction' (and even that felt like a giant fist in [58]). '最小的一部分' is a literal rendering. It suggests the water was split into several portions and the smallest one was picked out, and it loses the point that only a tiny fraction hit them.

findings.current: 大海得了暗示，也跟着动了起来。
findings.proposed: 大海也闻风而动。
findings.reason: '得了暗示' is a word-for-word rendering of 'cue' and reads as translationese. 'Take its cue' means the sea followed the lead of the wind and clouds, and '闻风而动' says exactly that in idiomatic Chinese, with a fitting echo of the wind.

findings.current: 小艇很快就越过了四十五度的倾斜角度。

findings.reason: 'I was now at the lower end' describes his position after the boat tipped. '我到了' suggests he moved there himself, which goes against 'everything was reversed'.

findings.reason: 'Sank down the back of the swell' means coming down the swell's rear slope. '往下沉' suggests sinking underwater, which would mislead given the boat had just been swamped.

findings.proposed: 我好不容易挂上了两个。
findings.reason: '设法' is the stock translationese for 'manage'. Here 'managed' means 'got two done with difficulty' ([45]: each hook got harder), which '好不容易' renders idiomatically.

findings.reason: The draft starts with the comparison clause '我比……还要快' and then adds a separate 把-clause, which follows the English order (Faster than…, I hooked…) and reads as two clauses that don't join up. In Chinese the speed comparison sits more naturally after the action as a comment on it. The meaning is unchanged.

findings.current: 此时救生艇已经盖住了，防水布也用压条固定好了，只有我这一头没有。

findings.reason: '只有我这一头没有' trails off with a bare 没有 that has no object, so it is unclear what is missing. Moving 'except at my end' to the front as '除了我这一头' covers both 'covered' and 'battened down', as the English does. '盖上了' is also clearer than '盖住了'.

findings.current: 木筏被折腾得格外厉害：它被拽出水面，一路蹦跳着被拖着走。
findings.proposed: 木筏被折腾得格外厉害，被拽出了水面，一路蹦跳着拖行。
findings.reason: The line has three 被-passives, a redundant 它, and the clumsy '蹦跳着被拖着走' with two 着. '一路蹦跳着拖行' is natural, and the glossed sense of 'drag along' (拖行) stays recognisable.

findings.current: 接着来了一道涌浪，它尤其执意要把我们卷走。

findings.reason: The 它 is redundant: it copies the English relative clause ('that was…'). '尤其' is normally used to single out one item from a group ('尤其是…'), so it does not fit as a degree adverb before '执意'. '格外' is the idiomatic way to say 'particularly'.

findings.current: 即便他表示过抗议，我也没有听见。
findings.proposed: 就算他抗议过，我也没有听见。
findings.reason: '表示过抗议' is a formal verb-plus-noun construction that sounds like an official statement and clashes with the wry tone about the tiger. A plain verb is more natural and says the same thing.

findings.current: 我的空间并不大。
findings.proposed: 留给我的空间并不多。
findings.reason: '我的空间并不大' copies the English structure and sounds as if the narrator owns a space and is describing its size. 'I did not have much space' is about how much room he was left, and '留给我的空间并不多' says that idiomatically.

findings.proposed: 跳上防水布，把它朝船尾展开，将老虎理查德·帕克关在里面，再挤到布下，从艇内尽力把布钩牢

findings.current: v. 啪地一下（猛然）变成（某状态）；突然折断

findings.current: 沉下去；往下沉

findings.current: 直到此时，我所见过的都还只是些小水丘。
findings.proposed: 在此之前，我见过的都只不过是些小水丘。

va.why: The problem is real: a boat does not '越过' an angle. But '转眼' (in the blink of an eye) overstates 'swiftly'; '很快' is exact. Keeping '倾斜角度' matches [49] and [56].
'I was now at the lower end' describes where he found himself after the tilt. '到了' suggests he moved there. '处在' is exact.
The English repeats 'up and down' three times word for word to show monotony. The draft varies it ('降了又升'). '起起落落' repeated three times keeps the sameness and is natural Chinese.

'Managed' here means he got two done with difficulty ([45]: each hook got harder). '好不容易' says this naturally. '设法' is stock translationese.

'我比缝纫机缝一块布还要快，把…' reads as two clauses that don't join up. Putting the action first and the speed comparison after it is natural Chinese and keeps every element: both sides, hooked down, faster than a sewing machine working cloth.
The bare '只有我这一头没有' is vague. '除了我这一头' at the front covers both 'covered' and 'battened down', as 'except at my end' does in the English. All clauses are kept.

va.why: The redundant 它 and the doubled 着 are real problems. But the proposal's '一路蹦跳着拖行' loses the passive and could read as the raft doing the dragging. '拽出了水面' also turns the ongoing 'being pulled out' into one completed event. The amended line keeps the passive and the progressive sense, and the colon shows the second half spells out the rough treatment.
The 它 is a calque of the English relative clause. '格外' is the natural degree adverb before '执意'; '尤其' is not. The meaning is unchanged.
'表示过抗议' is officialese and clashes with the wry tone. '就算他抗议过' is exact and natural.

va.why: '我的空间并不大' is indeed ambiguous: it sounds as if he owns a space and is describing its size. But '留给我的' adds 'left for me', which the English does not say. '我没有多少空间' is exact ('did not have much space') and idiomatic.
The current summary leaves out the object of 展开, and '把它固定住' can be read as tying down the tiger. The proposal names the tarpaulin, and '钩牢' matches the hooking described in the text.
In 'snap to tautness' the ropes go suddenly tight; they do not break. '突然折断' gives the opposite sense and would mislead learners. The proposed gloss keeps only the sense used here.

va.why: In this past narrative, 'could be' means the job was sometimes complex, which the next sentence shows. '这可能是' reads as a guess the narrator is making now. '有时会很复杂' is precise.

va.amended_proposed: 我来的时候，已有五名全职的分解表写手在一间后屋里工作，屋里排满了办公桌，窗外是一片停车场。
va.why: The problem is real: in '屋里排满了办公桌，俯瞰着…', 俯瞰 has no clear subject. 俯瞰 itself is the standard dictionary rendering of 'overlook', and the gloss keeps it. '正对着' changes 'has a view of' to 'directly faces'. '窗外是一片停车场' fixes the subject, keeps the view sense and reads naturally.

va.amended_proposed: 这项限制让人憋闷，这一点从下面这个事实就能看出来：其中两名写手开始给当地的小型报纸兼职当剧评人，借此一抒己见。
va.why: All three problems are real: 小报 suggests tabloids, '宣泄观点' is a bad collocation, and 'two of the writers' should be 其中两名. But '几家' adds a count the EN does not give, and '小报纸' still sounds close to 小报. '小型报纸' is neutral and precise.
'形式是……' is translationese. '重新“吐”出来，变成……' keeps every listed item, marks the metaphor and reads naturally. '各自的台词句数' correctly renders 'each speaks'.
'all-day' means throughout the day. 全天候 means around the clock or in all weathers, which overstates the service. 全天 is exact.

va.amended_proposed: 上班地点离我家不远，骑自行车就能到，而且他们要找的人只需每天上午来上班。
va.why: The ambiguity of '一个上午' is real. But in the proposal, 只 can attach to '找个人' (only one person) rather than to mornings. In the EN, 'only' limits the job to mornings. '要找的人只需每天上午来上班' puts 只 on the mornings.
Adding a separate clause '他名叫…' is translationese. The pre-modifier '一个名叫加里·马什的年轻人的独创' is natural Chinese and equally precise.

In Chinese, putting a parenthetical right after the noun it describes ('这家公司（至今仍生意兴隆）的一员') is acceptable. In the proposal, '（它至今仍生意兴隆）' follows 一员, so it seems to describe the wrong word. '名字起得出人意料' is not clearly better than '有个出人意料的名字'. Not clearly more natural or more precise.

va.amended_proposed: 他还看出他们有多讨厌工作中要阅读的那一部分，并巧妙地想出了分解表这个办法，用来提取他们所需的材料。
va.why: '作为…的一种办法' is translationese, as the reviewer says. But the added comma after 看出 makes it less clear who devised the breakdowns, since 并… can be read as part of what he observed. '用这种办法来提取' is also clumsy because 这种办法 has no clear referent. The amended line keeps 办法 for 'a way of', and the subject 他 stays clear.
'太不加掩饰地冷嘲热讽' is stiff. '冷嘲热讽得太露骨，不适合这份工作' keeps both 'too' and 'openly', plus 'for the job', and is more natural.
'例如…比如…' repeats itself. 诸如 with dashes sets off the example and makes the main clause clear. The content is unchanged.
'do my own writing' means 写自己的东西. '从事自己的写作' is stiff and bookish. 能 and 会 both render 'would leave' acceptably here.
'整理成剧情梗概、人物描述等内容的分解表' is missing a verb. Adding 包含 makes the noun phrase grammatical.

va.amended_proposed: v. 为……承保；为……提供保险
va.why: The problem is real: these companies are the insurers, so 投保 (buying insurance) is the opposite of what the sentence means. But '给……保险' is not idiomatic, and '给……上保险' also means buying insurance. '为……提供保险' is unambiguous.
In 'bicycling distance', 'bicycling' is an attributive gerund. The file lists such forms as -ing headwords with n. (gambling, dismantling, editorializing), so the headword should be 'bicycling'.
Goes with index 14: as an attributive gerund, the word is n., not v. The meaning 骑自行车 is correct.

Elsewhere in the file a 'be …' headword also highlights the be-form (was wrong about, are … bad at, were supposed to). Here only 'spent in' is highlighted, so the headword does not match. 'spend…in' fits the passive highlight and the gloss （时间）花在……上.

'running around the block' is a free combination (verb + preposition + object), not the phrasal verb 'run around' (东奔西跑). Labelling it 短语 with a literal gloss teaches a false set phrase. The sentence keeps plenty of other annotations.
Learner dictionaries give Ltd as an abbreviation used after a company name, meaning 有限（责任）公司. 'adj. 有限的' is not how learners will find it in a dictionary.
'phrase' means a group of words or an expression, not 名称. Moving the contextual reading (the company name) into a bracketed note keeps the gloss accurate.
'gambler' (n. 赌徒) is a core word to memorise. The ZH renders it in 《少年赌徒》, and it is currently unannotated. The file also annotates words like waiter, juice and leader, so leaving it out is a gap.

In Chinese, '那班人' points back to the five writers in [18], which suggests the author's own former colleagues now use computers. 'the current crew' means whoever works there now. '如今那里的工作人员' removes that misreading.

'公司的整个运营很难监控' suggests the company's internal management is out of control. The context is about controlling who gets and copies the breakdowns. '整个Breakdown业务' fits 'operation' as the whole business, matches the summary, and is covered by the gloss 运营；业务.

vb.why: In this past-tense narrative, 'could be' means the job was sometimes complex, and [22] then gives the example. '这可能是一项复杂的工作' reads as a present-day guess about whether it is complex at all. '有时会很复杂' is both precise and natural.

In '屋里排满了办公桌，俯瞰着一片停车场', the subject of 俯瞰 is left hanging, so the current Chinese is confused. Folding both details into one attributive phrase (排满办公桌、正对着停车场的后屋) fixes this. '正对着' is a safe rendering of a room 'overlooking' a lot, since the EN does not say the room is up high.

vb.amended_proposed: 这项限制让人憋闷，这一点从下面这个事实就能看出来：其中两名写手开始给当地的小型报纸兼职当剧评人，借此一抒己见。
vb.why: The proposal is right that 小报 means a tabloid and that 宣泄观点 is a bad collocation. '其中两名' and '一抒己见' are both improvements. But '几家小报纸' adds a count the EN does not give, and '小报纸' is colloquial and still close to 小报. '当地的小型报纸' is neutral and exact.

'重新吐出来，形式是……' is a word-for-word copy of 'in the form of' and reads as translationese. '重新“吐”出来，变成……' keeps the meaning, and the quote marks flag the metaphor. '各自的台词句数' renders 'each speaks' correctly.
In Chinese, 全天候 means round-the-clock or all-weather. 'All-day', set against 'nightly', means throughout the day, so 全天的 is exact and also matches the gloss 'adj. 全天的'.

vb.amended_proposed: 上班地点离我家不远，骑自行车就能到，而且他们要找的人只需每天上午来上班。
vb.why: The current '只要一个上午来上班的人' really is ambiguous, because 一个上午 can mean 一上午. In the proposed '只需要找个人', the scope of 只 can drift onto 找个人 ('all they need is to find someone'). The EN restricts the hours: the job is mornings only. '要找的人只需每天上午来上班' puts 只 on 'mornings', which is exactly the point.
The tacked-on clause '他名叫加里·马什' copies the English word order and adds a needless 他. Putting the name in the modifier ('一个名叫加里·马什的年轻人的独创') is standard idiomatic Chinese and loses nothing.

A parenthesis wedged between '这家公司' and '的一员' breaks up the modifier–noun phrase and reads awkwardly. The new version moves the aside to the end of the clause without adding or dropping content, and '公司名字起得出人意料' is more natural than '它有个……名字', which copies 'possessed the name'.

vb.amended_proposed: 他还看出他们有多讨厌工作中要阅读的那一部分，便巧妙地设计出分解表，用这种办法来提取他们所需的材料。
vb.why: Replacing the translationese '作为……的一种办法' with '用这种办法来' is right. But the comma the proposal adds after 看出 makes things worse: '看出，他们有多讨厌……，并巧妙地设计出' can now be read as 'he saw that they hated it and that they devised breakdowns'. Dropping that comma and linking with 便 keeps Gary as the one who devised them.
'太不加掩饰地冷嘲热讽' (too + negated adverbial + verb) is a stiff copy of 'too openly cynical'. '冷嘲热讽得太露骨' keeps both 'too' and 'openly' with a natural complement structure, and the meaning is unchanged.
'例如……比如……' puts two near-synonymous connectives side by side, and the subject gets buried between commas. '诸如' plus dashes setting off the aside keeps the main clause clear and changes no content.
'从事自己的写作' is stiff and bookish next to the casual '大把时间'. 'Do my own writing' really means 写自己的东西, so the new version is just as precise and more idiomatic.
'整理成剧情梗概、人物描述等内容的分解表' can be misparsed as 'organised into content', and the modifier lacks a verb. Adding 包含 makes the structure complete and unambiguous.

vb.amended_proposed: v. 为……承保；为……提供保险
vb.why: The proposal is right that in this sentence the companies are the insurers, so '为……投保' gives the opposite role and must go. But '给……保险' is not idiomatic, and '给……上保险' would again mean the policyholder buying cover. '为……提供保险' gives the insurer's sense and matches the ZH '为电影摄制提供保险'.

In 'bicycling distance' (compare 'walking distance'), the word is a gerund modifying a noun. The file already lists such -ing forms under the -ing headword as n. (gambling in 'gambling leader', dismantling, editorializing), so 'bicycling' is the consistent headword.
This goes with #14. A gerund used attributively is a noun use, and per the user's rule the POS must match the use in this sentence, so the label is n., not v.

The highlight is only 'spent in'; the EN has 'were being spent in', so the headword's 'be' is not in the highlighted text. Every other be-headword in the file (be put on full-time, be wrong about, be supposed to) includes the be-form in its highlight. 'spend…in ← spent in' follows the file's own precedent 'reserve…for ← reserve for', and the gloss still fits.

'running around the block' is literal run + preposition around + object, not the phrasal verb 'run around' (东奔西跑；忙得团团转). Calling it a 短语 teaches a false fixed phrase. Both 'run' and 'around' are elementary, 'block' is already annotated, and the sentence keeps many other entries, so nothing a learner needs is lost.

Dictionaries label Ltd as an abbreviation of Limited, used after a company name. 'adj. （公司）有限（责任）的' is not how learners will meet it. The pipeline's POS pattern explicitly allows 'abbr.', and '有限（责任）公司' matches the ZH 'Breakdown Services有限公司'.
'phrase' never means 名称 in a dictionary. Giving 词语；说法 as the meaning and putting the contextual reference (the company name) in brackets is precise, and it does not clash with the ZH '这个名称'.
'Gambler' is a core word a learner should memorise, and the ZH renders it in 《少年赌徒》. Only 'teenaged' and 'gambling' are annotated in this sentence, so 'gambler n. 赌徒' fills a real gap.

'那班人' naturally points back to the five writers in [18], implying the author's own colleagues switched to computers. 'The current crew' means whoever works there now, so '如今那里的工作人员' removes a real misreading.

'公司的整个运营很难监控' suggests the company could not manage itself. The context (exceptions to the subscriber rule, a costly subscription, copies passed around) is about policing where breakdowns go and who uses them. '整个Breakdown业务' is more accurate and matches the summary.
